description.p: Tunnel Manager is a desktop client for the Cloudflare API. It connects with a scoped API token, lists the tunnels on an account, and lets you create them, publish public hostnames to them, inspect their connectors and remove them again — all through remotely managed tunnel configuration, so nothing has to be edited on a server by hand.

Registering a remote Linux host over SSH is optional. When you do, the application can start, stop, restart and inspect the cloudflared systemd service on that host through a fixed set of allowed operations, with strict host-key verification and no arbitrary command execution. Every Cloudflare feature works without configuring SSH at all.
This is an unofficial third-party client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by Cloudflare, Inc.

First stable release: a Tauri desktop client for Cloudflare Tunnels, public hostnames and DNS, zone visibility, optional SSH remote control and local cloudflared control. Light, dark and system themes follow the GNOME accent colour.
